decisions.question: What is the current Core V0 research-universe eligibility principle?
existingCanonicalEvidence: stock.sma.close.v1 defines MA60 as a deterministic candidate
Opportunity shadow 60MA gate remained open and was not PM-frozen
decisions.canonicalConflict: Prior Opportunity shadow policy treats 60MA as factor/ranking context, not a hard gate; that policy is not rewritten.
availableChoicesSupportedByEvidence: Formalize as Core V0 L1 research policy with WS2 evidence dependency
decisions.recommendedOption: Formalize as Core V0 L1 research policy only
decisions.why: Explicit NEW OWNER DECISION in this task; it is deterministic when canonical Close and formal MA60 evidence are available.
decisions.pitImplication: Close and MA60 must be bound to the same session/as_of T, 60 accepted observations, lineage, and continuity state.
decisions.researchImplication: Unavailable MA60 cannot pass or fail the gate; it blocks that symbol/date from legal research evaluation.
decisions.blocksCapability: Core V0 date-level eligibility until WS2 MA60 evidence is available.
decisions.doesNotBlock: WS1 implementation, A1/A2 reference audit, A3/Catch-up policy audit, or documentation closure.

decisions.question: What exact technical authority supplies MA60(T)?
existingCanonicalEvidence: arithmetic mean of last 60 accepted daily closes
decisions.ownerIntent: Use MA60 as a common eligibility gate.
decisions.canonicalConflict: WS2 general continuity PASS and formal publication remain bounded; no WS2 implementation is authorized here.
availableChoicesSupportedByEvidence: Consume WS2 formal Technical Evidence when available
decisions.recommendedOption: Consume WS2 formal Technical Evidence; no WS3-local duplicate calculator
decisions.why: Preserves technical ownership and existing indicator-specific semantics.
decisions.pitImplication: Exact required/actual window, as_of, continuity, algorithm/version, and lineage are mandatory.
decisions.researchImplication: Disposition is READY_AFTER_WS2_MA60_EVIDENCE, not universal READY.
decisions.blocksCapability: Date-level L1 eligibility where MA60 evidence is unavailable.

decisions.question: Which reference identity defines the valid pre-breakout level?
existingCanonicalEvidence: No Core V0 frozen reference contract
decisions.ownerIntent: Near an important reference known before or at T.
decisions.canonicalConflict: No approved reference type is canonical for Core V0.
decisions.why: Evidence does not authorize selecting one; coding convenience is not authority.
decisions.pitImplication: Reference must be constructed only from information <= T and versioned.
decisions.researchImplication: A1 cannot freeze formation until reference authority exists.

decisions.question: What deterministic fields establish near-reference and structure-improving semantics?
existingCanonicalEvidence: Technical evidence primitives without Core V0 formation approval
decisions.ownerIntent: Not yet breakout, improving structure, near valid reference.
decisions.canonicalConflict: No exact fields or thresholds are frozen.
decisions.why: RSI/MACD/volume or proximity thresholds cannot be invented.
decisions.pitImplication: Every formation field must be observable <= T.
decisions.researchImplication: A1 remains blocked by structure/reference authority.
decisions.doesNotBlock: Common L1 contract and evidence classification.

decisions.question: What pre-existing reference and deterministic confirmation define breakout at T?
existingCanonicalEvidence: No frozen Core V0 reference/confirmation authority
decisions.ownerIntent: Valid pre-existing reference, breakout at T, confirmation requirement.

decisions.why: No supported threshold or breakout formula may be selected by this task.

decisions.researchImplication: A2 remains blocked by reference and confirmation authority.

decisions.question: Are volume/RSI/MACD/extended-breakout facts formation or evidence?

decisions.pitImplication: Any promoted field must have an as-of-safe technical contract.
decisions.researchImplication: No indicator becomes A2 identity by implication.
